notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ object-attribute regional services to the exact official RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. The development profile implements no-name regional object registration, additive region association/unassociation, per-(object-class, attribute, region) active/passive subscription state, active-overlap-filtered no-time Update Attribute Values routing, and the official optional RegionHandleSet reflection marker. Passive regional triples remain declared and keep their region lifecycle fence but cannot arrange discovery, scope, or reflection; re-subscribing a triple changes its mode. The direct-source Relaxed DDM policy is separately proven through exact-boundary registration, discovery, and reflection routing; broader relaxation matrices remain open. A bounded explicit-source timestamped object-update composition also exercises the declared regional services across a Time Constrained disable/re-enable transition while preserving the source RegionHandle and callback metadata; broader timestamped/retraction behavior remains outside this API contract. Named regional registration, Request Attribute Value Update With Regions, advisory scope transitions, default-region synthesis, save/restore, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
